name: Astrovibe Horoscopes – Shortcode
author: astrovibe

sections.description:
The Astrovibe Horoscope Plugin for WordPress allows you to display daily horoscopes for your visitors.
This free plugin is lightweight, responsive, and easy to install. You can add the horoscopes anywhere on your site with a simple shortcode.

It works seamlessly with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and other page builders and adapts to any WordPress theme.

Key Features

  • Daily horoscope for the 12 zodiac signs (Aries to Pisces).
  • Easy-to-use shortcode: [astrovibe_horoscopes].
  • Modern responsive design optimized for mobile.
  • Secure external links opening in a new tab.
  • Optional Astrovibe credit (opt-in only).
  • Fully compatible with WordPress ≥ 5.0.

Usage

  • Basic shortcode:
    [astrovibe_horoscopes]

  • With a custom CSS class:
    [astrovibe_horoscopes class=”mt-6″]

  • Show optional credit (opt-in):
    [astrovibe_horoscopes show_credit=”1″]
sections.installation:
1. Download the .zip file of the plugin.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file, click Install Now, and then Activate.
  4. Add the shortcode [astrovibe_horoscopes] in your posts, pages, or widgets.
sections.faq:
What is the Astrovibe Horoscope Plugin for WordPress?

It’s a free plugin that displays daily horoscopes for the 12 zodiac signs.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, it’s 100% free with no subscription required.

How do I install the plugin?

Download the .zip, upload it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then install and activate.

Does it work with Elementor and Divi?

Yes, you can insert the shortcode [astrovibe_horoscopes] in a “Shortcode” widget.

Is it compatible with Gutenberg?

Yes, simply use the “Shortcode” block.

Are horoscopes updated automatically?

Yes, links are generated dynamically for the current date.
